0x0000001E.name: KMODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED
0x0000001E.description: A kernel-mode program generated an exception that the error handler did not catch. Often caused by buggy drivers or hardware issues.
first_steps: Check Event ID 1001 in System log

0x0000003B.name: SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION
0x0000003B.description: An exception occurred while executing a routine transitioning from non-privileged to privileged code. Frequently driver-related.
first_steps: Boot into Safe Mode to isolate

0x0000007E.name: SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED
0x0000007E.description: A system thread generated an unhandled exception. Often related to driver incompatibility.

0x0000009F.name: DRIVER_POWER_STATE_FAILURE
0x0000009F.description: A driver is in an inconsistent or invalid power state during system power transitions (sleep/hibernate/shutdown).

0x000000C2.name: BAD_POOL_CALLER
0x000000C2.description: The current thread made an incorrect pool memory allocation request.

0x000000D1.name: DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL
0x000000D1.description: A kernel-mode driver attempted to access pageable memory at an elevated IRQL level.

0x00000124.name: WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR
0x00000124.description: A fatal hardware error was detected by the Windows Hardware Error Architecture (WHEA). Indicates hardware-level failure.
first_steps: Check WHEA event log for specific error source

0x0000013A.name: KERNEL_MODE_HEAP_CORRUPTION
0x0000013A.description: The kernel heap manager detected corruption in a heap.
first_steps: Run Driver Verifier with heap validation

0x00000154.name: UNEXPECTED_STORE_EXCEPTION
0x00000154.description: A store component (typically storage driver or file system) caught an unexpected exception.
first_steps: Check SMART data for drive health

0x0000007F.name: UNEXPECTED_KERNEL_MODE_TRAP
0x0000007F.description: A trap was generated in kernel mode that the kernel failed to catch. Often indicates hardware failure.

0x000000EF.name: CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED
0x000000EF.description: A critical system process terminated unexpectedly.

0x00000050.name: PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA
0x00000050.description: System tried to access a page of memory that wasn't present in physical memory.
first_steps: Boot from safe mode to test
